fieldValues.title: The engine's Blueprint tools describe a single-type document
fieldValues.summary: blueprint brief gives field tables for the root type only, no vocabulary values and ids in place of names; blueprint schema hangs every relation off the root record, so neither can describe a document of several linked types.
evidence: blueprint brief on the minutes Blueprint: payload.types has 1 of 11 types
blueprint schema: the about relation becomes one root-level array with maxItems 1
fieldValues.body: Enough for the decision log, the only earlier Blueprint with a Protocol. The MCP server exposes the same brief as each Blueprint's prompt.
